opportunity-scout-delivery-(morning).name: Opportunity Scout Delivery (morning)
opportunity-scout-delivery-(morning).description: 9:30 AM daily — sends whatever the 02:00 research run queued, if anything. No research. Cheap by design; most days it finds nothing.

side-income-delivery-(morning).name: Side-Income Delivery (morning)
side-income-delivery-(morning).description: Sunday 9 AM — sends the message the 01:00 analysis run queued, if there is one. No research. Cheap by design.

Silent runs are the norm.

weekly-vp-performance-edge.description: Mondays 7 AM — one tactical VPE tip before weekly goal review.
